Ingrid Mercer
ingrid.mercer@example.com | Denver, CO
Ingrid Mercer has 6 years of experience in backend and distributed systems.
Most recently, Senior Backend Engineer at Beacon Networks (2023-2026), where
they introduced Terraform-managed infrastructure, cutting provisioning time by
79%. Before that, Backend Engineer at Amber Analytics (2020-2023). Education:
B.S. Software Engineering, University of Pittsburgh, 2019. Core skills: Redis,
Terraform, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST API design, TypeScript, Distributed
systems.
